newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Reputed drug lord gunned down in Colombian capital.
newsitem.headline: Reputed drug lord gunned down in Colombian capital.

text.p: A reputed drug lord was gunned down on Wednesday in a shootout in a luxury shopping mall on the north end of Bogota, Colombian televison said.

The QAP televison network said Efrain Hernandez, a former policeman who had cashed in on Colombia's booming narcotics trade, was shot and killed in a private office in the tony Santa Barbara shopping mall sometime late on Wednesday.
One other man was killed in the shooting and a third was wounded and being treated in a nearby hospital, the TV report said.
Police could not be reached for immediate comment.

Hernandez, who had amassed a real estate empire since 1990 and was said to be the leader of a splinter group of the Cali drug cartel, was married to a prominent Colombian model arrested for drug possession last month in Paris.
